description: Start a paper bot. trigger is one of: { trader } to copy one trader; { signal } to copy whale buys that match conditions; { market, outcome, rule } to trade one market by a price rule. Only paper bots can be made here; no money moves.

buyWindows.description: Market bots on the 5 and 15 minute markets: one or two parts of each market it may buy in, seconds from the open, e.g. [{fromSeconds:0,untilSeconds:180},{fromSeconds:720,untilSeconds:900}]. Left out buys at any time.

copy.description: Trader bots: which of the trader's trades to copy (minimum bet, categories, price range, per-game cap and more). Prices run 0 to 1. Left out copies every trade.

categories.description: Copy only these categories or kinds of market, e.g. ["sports"], ["tennis"], ["nba", "nfl"], ["politics"]. Empty copies every market.

endsWithinHours.description: Copy only markets expected to end within this many hours of the copy, so no bet is held longer (24 holds nothing past a day). Null or left out is any market.

maxAmountUsd.description: Copy only trades of the trader's of at most this many dollars. Null is no ceiling.

maxBets.description: Stop opening new bets after this many a day, or in all.

maxPerGameUsd.description: The most the bot puts into one game across every market on it (the winner, spreads, totals and props), in dollars. A copy takes only what is left under it. Null or left out is no limit.

maxPrice.description: Highest price to buy at, 0.01 to 0.99 (0.95 is 95 cents). Null is no ceiling.

minAmountUsd.description: Minimum bet: copy only trades of the trader's of at least this many dollars. Each fill is judged on its own. Null copies any size.

minPrice.description: Lowest price to buy at, 0.01 to 0.99 (0.4 is 40 cents). Null is no floor.

newPositionsOnly.description: Copy only trades that open a new position for the trader; adds to a position they hold are left.

oneSidePerMarket.description: Never hold both sides of one market.

dailyCapUsd.description: Trader bots: the daily limit on buys in dollars. Left out is no limit.

historyDays.description: Signal bots: start with matching trades from this many days back.

mirrorExits.description: Trader bots: sell when the trader sells.

name.description: Signal and market bots only; a trader bot is named after its trader.

pauseLimits.description: Market bots: pause by itself when one is reached.

dayLossUsd.description: Pause after losing this much in your day.

drawdownUsd.description: Pause after falling this far below its best running total.

minWinRatePct.description: Pause when its win rate is under this, with winRateTrades.

winRateTrades.description: How many of its last closed trades the win rate counts.

sellBeforeCloseSeconds.description: Market bots on the 5 and 15 minute markets: sell a holding this many seconds before each market closes.

series.description: Market bots: follow the market's repeating series.

sizing.description: Bet size: { usd } per trade, or { percent, maxUsd } of the source trade. Defaults to $100 a trade.

cents.description: Cents over the trader's price, 0 to 20.

percent.description: Percent over the trader's price, 0.5 to 20.

slippage.description: Price tolerance (slippage): how far past the trader's price a real-money copy may pay. A paper bot keeps it for Go live and its backtest scores at it; paper fills are priced from what live copies really paid. 2.5% by default.

signal.description: Conditions a whale buy must meet.

endsWithinHours.description: Only markets expected to end within this many hours of the buy (24 holds no bet past a day).

entry.description: open: first buys only; add: adds to a position; all: both.

keywords.description: Words that must appear in the market title.

maxPerGameUsd.description: The most the bot puts into one game across every market on it (the winner, spreads, totals and props), in dollars. A buy takes only what is left under it; left out is no limit.

minUsd.description: Smallest whale buy to copy, in dollars.

priceMax.description: Highest entry price, 0 to 1. 0.85 or less skips near-certain sides.

skipLosingTraders.description: Leave out traders on a losing 90-day record. On unless false. A backtest uses each trader's record today.

traders.description: Trader refs to copy only these traders. Each counts toward the 100 traders a day.

dropsBy.description: Buy when the price drops this many dollars of price from its first reading.

moveWithinSeconds.description: With dropsBy or risesBy: the move has to happen within this many seconds, measured from the highest (a drop) or lowest (a rise) price in that time, 5 to 600. Left out, the move is measured from the first reading.

priceMax.description: Only buy when the side costs at most this, 0 to 1.

priceMin.description: Only buy when the side costs at least this, 0 to 1.

streak.description: Series bots only: buy on a market only once this many markets of the series before it all settled this way. yes is the first outcome (Up on an up-or-down series).

trailFrom.description: Start the trailing stop once the price reaches this.

trailFromPoints.description: Start the trailing stop once the price is this far above what was paid.

trailPoints.description: Trailing stop: sell once the price falls this far below its high since the buy.
